measurement: tympanic membrane and annulus presence in the holotype description
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype MUSM 31196 (IWU 178), printed as 'adult male' (collected 17 May 2012, Laguna Udrecocha, 3936 m a.s.l.), SVL 18.9 mm, preserved; one individual. Paratypes as printed ('A total of 33', all from inside the PPPF except MUSM 31199-31202 and NMP6V 75526-29): 10 adult females MUSM 31977, 31980, 31987, 31201, NMP6V 75076, 75522, 75523, 75528, 75529, 75534; 20 adult males MUSM 31186, 31195, 31199, 31202, 31975, 31979, 31988, 31989, 31992, 31993, NMP6V 75077-75079, 75524-75527, 75533, UMMZ 244726, 244727; 3 juveniles MUSM 31187, 31990, 31200. Methods (exact): 'Amphibians were preserved in 96% ethanol and stored in 70% ethanol.'; 'We measured the following variables to the nearest 0.1 mm with digital calipers under a stereomicroscope:' (eye listed as 'horizontal eye diameter (ED)'; unit mm); 'The tympanic region of two specimens (MUSM 31199, NMP6V 75534) was opened to see if a tympanic annulus is present under the skin.' Both are paratypes, so the holotype itself was not reported as opened. The quote is the head sentence of the holotype description, one cut marked; the cut text covers head proportions, snout, nostrils, canthus, eyelid and the supratympanic fold and none of it qualifies this value. The Diagnosis (a run-in paragraph under Generic placement) lists '(2) tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus absent;', and the Abstract ('absence of both tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus') and Comparisons ('Both Pristimantis attenboroughi and Phrynopus chaparroi lack a tympanum ...') say the same. Tables 3 and 4 and the Variation section print no tympanum measurement, so text, Diagnosis and tables do not conflict. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

measurement: tympanic membrane and annulus presence in the holotype description
value: tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus absent
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype CORBIDI 20553, printed as adult female (SVL 34.3 mm), preserved; one individual. Paratypes as printed (Type material): '3 ♀ adults, 4 ♂ adults, collected on 22 Feb. 2019 at the same place as holotype', CORBIDI 20432-35, 20436-39 (eight codes for seven specimens), and '5 ♀ adults, 2 ♂ adults, collected with the holotype', CORBIDI 20551, 20555-58, 20552, 20554 (no individual sexes printed for these). The paper's sexes for 20432-20439 conflict: the Figure 4 caption prints female 20432 and males 20438 and 20439; Variation prints females 20433, 20434 and 20435 and males 20436, 20437 and 20438, but calls 20439 both male ('in male CORBIDI ... 20439') and female ('the belly lacks large dark blotches in female CORBIDI ... 20439'). Methods (exact): 'We euthanized specimens with benzocaine 20%, preserved them in 10% formalin, and stored them in 70% alcohol' (in the CORBIDI collection); 'We used a digital caliper under a microscope to measure the following to the nearest 0.1 mm:' (eye listed as 'eye diameter (ED)', no further definition; unit mm); the Methods do not say how the tympanic region was examined. The quote is the head sentence of the holotype description, one cut marked; the cut text covers head width and length proportions, snout, nostrils, canthus, lips and eyelid and none of it qualifies this value. The Diagnosis lists '(2) tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus absent;' and Comparisons separate the species from P. auriculatus, P. mariellaleo and P. peruanus on this character. Table 1 has no tympanum row (it lists ED only), so text, Diagnosis and table do not conflict; the paratype count and sex conflicts are unrelated to the tympanum. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

measurement: tympanic membrane and annulus condition in the holotype description
value: tympanic membrane present, tympanic annulus weakly defined
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype MUSM 32204 (field number KT 75), printed as adult gravid female, SVL 58.3 mm, preserved; one individual. Paratypes as printed: 'Five individuals': 'an adult female' MUSM 32206 (field number KT 76), 'two juveniles' MUSM 32211 (KT 84) and 32213 (KT 72), these three 'collected with the holotype'; 'two adult females' MUSM 32201 (KT 89) and MUSM 32205 (KT 87), same locality, collected 28 September 2013. Methods (exact): 'specimens were fixed using 10% formalin and stored in 70% ethanol.'; 'Morphometric measurements in millimeters (mm) were taken with a digital caliper Mitutoyo (nearest to 0.1 mm).' (eye listed as 'ED horizontal eye diameter'); 'Condition of the tympanum was assessed by visual examination under stereoscope.' The quote is the single long head-and-body sentence of the holotype description, with two cuts marked; the cut text covers body, snout, eye, crests (including 'pretympanic crests well defined'), parotoid glands, limbs, skin and tongue measures and none of it qualifies this value. Same sentence: 'tympanum diameter smaller than eye diameter' (no number printed; Table 2 has no tympanum row, only ED 4.4 mm). The Diagnosis prints '(7) tympanic membrane present, tympanic annulus weakly defined;' and the Abstract, Variation and Comparisons agree on presence; the text, Diagnosis and table do not conflict. Only the adult female holotype is described for tympanum condition; juveniles and the other paratypes are not. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

measurement: tympanic membrane and annulus presence in the holotype description
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype MUSM 32733 (field number IWU 367), printed as 'an adult male', SVL 25.7 mm (holotype measurements), fixed in 96% ethanol and stored in 70% ethanol (Methods: 'The holotype was fixed in 96% ethanol and stored in 70% ethanol.'); one individual. Paratypes as printed: 'Two adult males', NMP-P6V 75060 (field number IWU 359) and MUSM 31165 (field number IWU 123). Methods: 'We measured the following variables to the nearest 0.1 mm with digital calipers under a stereomicroscope:', a list that includes 'horizontal eye diameter (ED)' and 'horizontal tympanum diameter (TD)'; no TD value is printed for any type (the holotype measurements and Table 3 have no TD row), and the Methods do not say how tympanum condition was scored. The quote is the first sentence of the holotype description, one cut marked; the cut text covers head proportions, snout, nostrils, canthus, loreal region, lips, eyelid tubercles and the occipital fold and none of it qualifies this value. Diagnosis prints '(2) tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus absent;', the Abstract says the species is 'mainly characterised by absence of tympanum', and the Comparison prints 'Pristimantis ventrimarmoratus and P. sinschi both lack a tympanum'. The Variation paragraph does not mention the tympanum. Table 4 (the compared species P. albertus) prints a TY row (0.6-1.2 mm) that belongs to that other species. The paper has unrelated internal inconsistencies (Table 3 EW mean 3.1 outside its stated range 2.4-3.0; paratype NMP-P6V 75060 collected 'at the type locality' (1800 m) in the text, 1615 m in Table 1) that do not touch the tympanum. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
